messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Order begins", then "Check stock", then the decision "Item available?". Its Yes branch goes to "Reserve item"; its No branch goes to "Request replenishment". Both alternative stages lead directly to "Notify customer", which leads to "Order review complete".

response.text: Order Begins is connected with Check stock which is then connected with Item available? If Item available? is No then Reserve item and if Item available? is Yes then Request replenishment and if Item available? is Yes then Item available? Also, Reserve item is connected with both Order review complete and Order review complete which is then connected with both Order review complete and Order review complete. If Reservation dey is No then Reserve item and if Reservation dey is Yes then Request replenishment and if Reservation dey is No then Order review complete.
